claim_ceiling: MAXIMUM JUSTIFIED: Disabling adopt-any-observed-key reconstruction restores discriminability in the sense that verbatim manipulation check passes (0/40=0.0 for all pipelines, Wilson upper 0.0876 <=0.15), confirming the parent 39/40=0.975 ceiling was a reconstruction artifact. However, under the discriminating correct-family-required binding rule (cross-family key adoption forbidden), neither hierarchical theme-diversified retrieval nor WebAPI endpoint+method+auth-scope mining provides higher-leverage alias-OOD resolution than flat top-5 RAG on the tested synthetic orthogonal header/body/auth + mixed multi-channel splits with minimal derived dict (url/method/url_path/url_query/url_segments/headers_observed/body_observed). All pipelines tie at 21/40=0.525 pooled correct (Wilson [0.375,0.671], binomial p=1.1e-08 vs 0.10, McNemar vs B-EXACT-MATCH p=1.27e-05), coverage gain 0.0 CI [0.0,0.0] p=1.0, density gain -0.105 significantly negative. False_accept 0.25 >0.15 threshold (driven by mixed 0/10), ECE 0.257 >0.15. WebAPI and hierarchical produce identical 84 themes, identical retrieved_ids, identical entropy — they are the same algorithm with different labels on this synthetic. This is a BOUNDED FALSIFICATION: retrieval/mining diversity is not the bottleneck for these specific families/compositions under correct-family-required binding with minimal derived dict. Does not falsify semantic resolution globally, nor endpoint discovery on real Fetch/WebMCP/OpenAPI substrates, nor live BrowserGym 1280x720 observation noise where derived_context is noisy. The contamination magnitude (adopt-any-key 0.975 -> verbatim 0.0 -> correctfamily 0.525) is quantified. C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE remains EXPERIMENTAL at rule-based reconstruction ceiling artifact + MIXED bounded (no retrieval complementarity under correct-family gating).
